1 -  The Speedrunning Mod and SuperBLT are the obligatory mods and then MUST be used in all runs. Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. If the host player has a lag at the start of a heist for around 1 sec or more the run will be rejected. This RNG Mod can be deactivated in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud.

4 - The Crew AI bots are allowed.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics. Only the host of the lobby can submit his recorded run. If the host submits a run in the DW and above category, he can also submit the run in the any difficulty co-op category.

9 - For the escape speedruns: You can start with the day of the heist of your choice if it's a multi-day-heist. The IGT is counted only for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - The lobby host must show the mods of all other players in the player list during the recording (preferably after crew stats are shown), or the other players must show their run with a video of their own POV when possible. If the verifier doesn't know what the other players were doing, like an OOB or a glitch, they must show their part of the run to be sure there is nothing happening that is not allowed. When the players decide to hide their actions, the run could be rejected in certain circumstances.

11 - The host can always submit his recording in the shuffle. For the 2/3/4 - player categories the host can also submit the video if all players have been in the game from the start and never left until 5 seconds (ingame time) before the heist ends (last frame).

12 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist, you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could work. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist: you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could works. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist: you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could works. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist: you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could works. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

9 - For the escape speedruns: You can start with the day of the heist of your choice if it's a multi-day-heist. The IGT is counted only for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - The lobby host must show the mods of all other players in the player list during the recording (preferably after crew stats are shown), or the other players must show their run with a video of their own POV when possible. If the verifier doesn't know what the other players were doing, like an OOB or a glitch, they must show their part of the run to be sure there is nothing happening that is not allowed. When the players decide to hide their actions, the run could be rejected in certain circumstances.

11 - The host can always submit his recording in the shuffle. For the 2/3/4 - player categories the host can also submit the video if all players have been in the game from the start and never left until 5 seconds (ingame time) before the heist ends (last frame).

12 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

9 - For the escape speedruns: You can start with the day of the heist of your choice if it's a multi-day-heist. The IGT is counted only for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - The lobby host must show the mods of all other players in the player list during the recording (preferably after crew stats are shown), or the other players must show their run with a video of their own POV when possible. If the verifier doesn't know what the other players were doing, like an OOB or a glitch, they must show their part of the run to be sure there is nothing happening that is not allowed. When the players decide to hide their actions, the run could be rejected in certain circumstances.

11 - The host can always submit his recording in the shuffle. For the 2/3/4 - player categories the host can also submit the video if all players have been in the game from the start and never left until 5 seconds (ingame time) before the heist ends (last frame).

12 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

1 -  The Speedrunning Mod and SuperBLT are the obligatory mods and then MUST be used in all runs. Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed and you can also submit your run in the "Any Difficulty Solo" category. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory of both solo categorys.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist, you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could work. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist: you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could works. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed and you can also submit your run in the "Any Difficulty Solo" category. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory of both solo categorys.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist, you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could work. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server: 

[“PAYDAY 2 SPEEDRUN“](https://discord.gg/2wgfGtbWUy)

For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed and you can also submit your run in the "Any Difficulty Solo" category. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory of both solo categorys.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist, you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could work. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server: 

[“PAYDAY 2 SPEEDRUN“](https://discord.gg/2wgfGtbWUy)

1 -  The Speedrunning Mod and SuperBLT are the obligatory mods and then MUST be used in all runs. Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed and you can also submit your run in the "Any Difficulty Solo" category. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory of both solo categorys.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist, you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could work. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

9 - For the escape speedruns: You can start with the day of the heist of your choice if it's a multi-day-heist. The IGT is counted only for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - The lobby host must show the mods of all other players in the player list during the recording (preferably after crew stats are shown), or the other players must show their run with a video of their own POV when possible. If the verifier doesn't know what the other players were doing, like an OOB or a glitch, they must show their part of the run to be sure there is nothing happening that is not allowed. When the players decide to hide their actions, the run could be rejected in certain circumstances.

11 - The host can always submit his recording in the shuffle. For the 2/3/4 - player categories the host can also submit the video if all players have been in the game from the start and never left until 5 seconds (ingame time) before the heist ends (last frame).

12 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. If the host player has a lag at the start of a heist for around 1 sec or more the run will be rejected. This RNG Mod can be deactivated in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud.

4 - The Crew AI bots are allowed.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics. Only the host of the lobby can submit his recorded run. If the host submits a run in the DW and above category, he can also submit the run in the any difficulty co-op category.

9 - For the escape speedruns: You can start with the day of the heist of your choice if it's a multi-day-heist. The IGT is counted only for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - The lobby host must show the mods of all other players in the player list during the recording (preferably after crew stats are shown), or the other players must show their run with a video of their own POV when possible. If the verifier doesn't know what the other players were doing, like an OOB or a glitch, they must show their part of the run to be sure there is nothing happening that is not allowed. When the players decide to hide their actions, the run could be rejected in certain circumstances.

11 - The host can always submit his recording in the shuffle. For the 2/3/4 - player categories the host can also submit the video if all players have been in the game from the start and never left until 5 seconds (ingame time) before the heist ends (last frame).

12 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist, you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could work. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. If the host player has a lag at the start of a heist for around 1 sec or more the run will be rejected. This RNG Mod can be deactivated in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud.

4 - The Crew AI bots are allowed.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics. Only the host of the lobby can submit his recorded run. If the host submits a run in the DW and above category, he can also submit the run in the any difficulty co-op category.

9 - For the escape speedruns: You can start with the day of the heist of your choice if it's a multi-day-heist. The IGT is counted only for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - The lobby host must show the mods of all other players in the player list during the recording (preferably after crew stats are shown), or the other players must show their run with a video of their own POV when possible. If the verifier doesn't know what the other players were doing, like an OOB or a glitch, they must show their part of the run to be sure there is nothing happening that is not allowed. When the players decide to hide their actions, the run could be rejected in certain circumstances.

11 - The host can always submit his recording in the shuffle. For the 2/3/4 - player categories the host can also submit the video if all players have been in the game from the start and never left until 5 seconds (ingame time) before the heist ends (last frame).

12 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist, you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could work. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist: you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could works. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist: you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could works. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

9 - For the escape speedruns: You can start with the day of the heist of your choice if it's a multi-day-heist. The IGT is counted only for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - The lobby host must show the mods of all other players in the player list during the recording (preferably after crew stats are shown), or the other players must show their run with a video of their own POV when possible. If the verifier doesn't know what the other players were doing, like an OOB or a glitch, they must show their part of the run to be sure there is nothing happening that is not allowed. When the players decide to hide their actions, the run could be rejected in certain circumstances.

11 - The host can always submit his recording in the shuffle. For the 2/3/4 - player categories the host can also submit the video if all players have been in the game from the start and never left until 5 seconds (ingame time) before the heist ends (last frame).

12 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. If the host player has a lag at the start of a heist for around 1 sec or more the run will be rejected. This RNG Mod can be deactivated in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud.

4 - The Crew AI bots are allowed.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics. Only the host of the lobby can submit his recorded run. If the host submits a run in the DW and above category, he can also submit the run in the any difficulty co-op category.

9 - For the escape speedruns: You can start with the day of the heist of your choice if it's a multi-day-heist. The IGT is counted only for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - The lobby host must show the mods of all other players in the player list during the recording (preferably after crew stats are shown), or the other players must show their run with a video of their own POV when possible. If the verifier doesn't know what the other players were doing, like an OOB or a glitch, they must show their part of the run to be sure there is nothing happening that is not allowed. When the players decide to hide their actions, the run could be rejected in certain circumstances.

11 - The host can always submit his recording in the shuffle. For the 2/3/4 - player categories the host can also submit the video if all players have been in the game from the start and never left until 5 seconds (ingame time) before the heist ends (last frame).

12 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist, you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could work. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed and you can also submit your run in the "Any Difficulty Solo" category. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory of both solo categorys.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist, you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could work. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server: 

[“PAYDAY 2 SPEEDRUN“](https://discord.gg/2wgfGtbWUy)

For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist: you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could works. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. If the host player has a lag at the start of a heist for around 1 sec or more the run will be rejected. This RNG Mod can be deactivated in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud.

4 - The Crew AI bots are allowed.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics. Only the host of the lobby can submit his recorded run. If the host submits a run in the DW and above category, he can also submit the run in the any difficulty co-op category.

9 - For the escape speedruns: You can start with the day of the heist of your choice if it's a multi-day-heist. The IGT is counted only for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - The lobby host must show the mods of all other players in the player list during the recording (preferably after crew stats are shown), or the other players must show their run with a video of their own POV when possible. If the verifier doesn't know what the other players were doing, like an OOB or a glitch, they must show their part of the run to be sure there is nothing happening that is not allowed. When the players decide to hide their actions, the run could be rejected in certain circumstances.

11 - The host can always submit his recording in the shuffle. For the 2/3/4 - player categories the host can also submit the video if all players have been in the game from the start and never left until 5 seconds (ingame time) before the heist ends (last frame).

12 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist, you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could work. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist: you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could works. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist: you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could works. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

Please READ [the rules](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/thread/v2elh) regarding the mod carefully BEFORE submitting a run. For the download click on SRC (speedrun.com) [resources](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources) and there on speedrunning mod. This rule counted since update 196.1 (23. Nov. 2018) and must be also used for downpatched runs till this update. For older updates you can use these mods but its not a must have.

2 - The RNG Mod, which is a part of the Speedrunning Mod, is allowed to be used. Warning: Some options of options can create an impossible rng situation. A run with impossible rng will be rejected, also if infinity slow motion is used. This RNG Mod can be disabled in the main page (middle-left) in the game.

3 - NO other mods are allowed. Make sure you don't have any visual mods somewhere installed. This means the mods_overrides folders, because they can be hidden like from wolf hud. 

4 - For any% category: The Crew AI bots are allowed. If your run doesn't have the Crew AI bots, you can also submit it in the botless subcategory.

4 - For botless category: The Crew AI bots are unallowed. You can also submit your run in the any% category.

4 - For glitchless category: Click on "Glitchless" and then on "show rules" to read the special rules on the bottom.

5 - Runs are unallowed to have any mutators or to be done in the Crime Spree and Career mode. The One Down mechanic is allowed to be used.

6 - The recording must begin in the preplanning screen and is unallowed to end before showing the crew stats at the end of the heist. This means each day and escapes in multi-day-heists, for example: If you do a one day heist and an escape is triggered afterwards, this escape doesn't count towards the final time, so you dont have to record this part.

7 - It is NOT allowed to hide any HUD elements (the HP and ammunition count, Bots and other players name, Timers and the mod list). It is allowed to mute the recording and if you want to put music over it. Other editing in the recording is unallowed.

8 - Submit only your IGT (in game time) not the RT (real time). The RT is exclusively for the full game Crime Spree leaderboards. The IGT is shown in the crew statistics.

9 - For the escape speedrun: You can start with the day of a heist of your choice, if it's a multi-day heist. The IGT is only counted for one day of a heist + escape.

10 - A Major Skip counts every time when an objective of a heist is skipped. Except the lucky rng like the open vault of GO bank at the start and all objectives who start with "find and..." / "find the...". This do not include a clueless guess like tagging the right truck in Election Day 1 when the objective says to find clues BEFORE. When an OOB (Out Of Bounds) glitch is done, this counts for players and bags. When an in-game glitch (duplication of bags) or an in-game mechanic (PBSH) is fixed or changed. This means it could happen that a run becomes later a Major Skip. Not fixed duplications can't be considered as a  Major Skip. Changing the objective line from stealth to loud is allowed.

Tips : Before running any heist: you can watch a video of the heist to see how it could works. Primarily the "Yakuza" perk deck and the skill "Frenzy" are usually used for many runs. For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:
